newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telemig still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telemig still a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers/Patrimonio said in a report they were maintaining their buy rating on Minas Gerais state-owned telecom firm Telemig.
-- It estimated Telemig would post net earnings of 324 million reais ($305.6 million) this year under the new accounting methodology compared with $338 million under the previous methodology.
-- "This reflects an increase in the income tax payable, due to a change in the income tax effective in 1997," it said.
-- Telemig preferred B shares were trading at 153.90 reais, down 0.32 percent.
